<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><entry><updated><![CDATA[2026-11-19T15:59:07.903Z]]></updated><category term="UPDATE"/><title><![CDATA[Apple TV becomes the new U.S. home of F1 ACADEMY™, the all-female racing series
]]></title><link href="https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/11/apple-tv-becomes-the-new-us-home-of-f1-academy-the-all-female-racing-series/"/><id><![CDATA[https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/11/apple-tv-becomes-the-new-us-home-of-f1-academy-the-all-female-racing-series/]]></id><author><name><![CDATA[Apple Newsroom]]></name></author><content><![CDATA[Apple and F1 ACADEMY™ today announced that the all-female racing series will stream on Apple TV in the United States beginning in 2027.]]></content><link href="https://www.apple.com/newsroom/images/2026/11/apple-tv-becomes-the-new-us-home-of-f1-academy-the-all-female-racing-series/tile/Apple-TV-F1-ACADEMY-hero-lp.jpg.og.jpg" rel="enclosure" title="Apple TV becomes the new U.S. home of F1 ACADEMY™, the all-female racing series" type="image/jpeg"/></entry></feed>
